ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Let f(x)=ax^2-x+b. It is known that the solution set of f(x)≥0 is the closed interval [-2,1], so the two zeros of f(x) are -2 and 1; and ≥0 holds between the two roots, indicating that the parabola opens downward. Thus we may set f(x)=a(x+2)(x-1). Expanding gives f(x)=a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a. Comparing coefficients with ax^2-x+b: the coefficient of the x term satisfies a=-1, and the constant term satisfies b=-2a=2. Substituting a=-1 and b=2 into bx^2-x+a≤0 gives 2x^2-x-1≤0. Since 2x^2-x-1=(2x+1)(x-1), we have (2x+1)(x-1)≤0. The coefficient of the quadratic term is positive, so the solution set is between the two roots, namely [-1/2,1].

method.method_draft: 把第一条不等式对应的二次函数记为 f(x)=ax^2-x+b。由题干读出 f(x)\ge 0 的解集是闭区间 [-2,1]，因此 f(x) 的两个零点为 -2 和 1，且因“\ge 0”在两根之间成立，所以抛物线开口向下。于是可设 f(x)=a(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a，与 ax^2-x+b 对比，x 项系数给出 a=-1，常数项给出 b=2。再代入要求的不等式 bx^2-x+a\le 0，得到 2x^2-x-1\le 0，即 (2x+1)(x-1)\le 0。由二次函数开口向上，解集为两根之间，得到 [-\frac12,1]。

method.method_draft: 令 f(t)=at^2-t+b。题干给出 f(t)\ge0 的解集为 [-2,1]。观察待求式 bx^2-x+a 与 f 的倒数变量关系：当 x\ne0 时，x^2 f(1/x)=x^2(a/x^2-1/x+b)=a-x+bx^2=bx^2-x+a。因此 bx^2-x+a\le0 等价于 f(1/x)\le0。由于 f(t)\ge0 只在 [-2,1] 上成立，所以 f(t)\le0 在区间外成立，即 t\in(-\infty,-2]\cup[1,+\infty)。令 t=1/x，解 1/x\in(-\infty,-2]\cup[1,+\infty)，得到 x\in[-1/2,0)\cup(0,1]。还需单独检查 x=0：原已知解集是有限闭区间且对应的是 f\ge0，所以 f 的开口向下，a<0；待求式在 x=0 时等于 a\le0，故 0 也属于解集。合并得到 [-\frac12,1]。

raw_record.final_cot: Let f(x)=ax^2-x+b. It is known that the solution set of f(x)≥0 is the closed interval [-2,1], so the two zeros of f(x) are -2 and 1; and ≥0 holds between the two roots, indicating that the parabola opens downward. Thus we may set f(x)=a(x+2)(x-1). Expanding gives f(x)=a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a. Comparing coefficients with ax^2-x+b: the coefficient of the x term satisfies a=-1, and the constant term satisfies b=-2a=2. Substituting a=-1 and b=2 into bx^2-x+a≤0 gives 2x^2-x-1≤0. Since 2x^2-x-1=(2x+1)(x-1), we have (2x+1)(x-1)≤0. The coefficient of the quadratic term is positive, so the solution set is between the two roots, namely [-1/2,1].
